singleSourceRule: All current mirrors derive current phase, gate and write boundary from this index and the active change-control. Historical headers and workflow files do not define current status.
readOrder: Step 1 Round 008 seal and sealed canonical
Step 3 final judge, completion evidence and live read-back
current task Acceptance, critic, judge, evidence and live read-back
chat history, reference images and general knowledge

active.role: project-wide authority, safety and operating rules
low-rework production method and downstream-usability contract

executableContract.currentVerificationMethod: Verify every seal binding at current HEAD and run the source-bound verifier in a detached worktree at the Phase 0 corrected entry; do not rewrite the seal for Project-source changes.

modelValidation.limitation: Step 3 validates the sealed model and transition tests. It is not evidence that the current browser runtime implements the canonical game or that real players completed runtime playtests.

legacyRuntime.allowedUse: technical history and temporary comparison only
legacyRuntime.forbiddenUse: may not be described as the canonical 1-10F implementation or receive incremental production polish during S02-P1

scopedVerdicts.PASS_CANONICAL: product meaning, IDs, state and trust boundaries are sealed
scopedVerdicts.PASS_CONTRACT: schema, validator, fixture and model contract are executable
scopedVerdicts.PASS_MODEL: the sealed model passed its stated simulations and transition tests
scopedVerdicts.PASS_VISUAL: required rendered states and viewports passed independent visual review
scopedVerdicts.PASS_ASSET: production assets passed decomposition, animation, budget, provenance and in-engine proof
scopedVerdicts.PASS_RUNTIME: canonical product is implemented and passed browser interaction and regression
scopedVerdicts.PASS_SERVER: authoritative transactions, ledger, recovery and security passed
scopedVerdicts.PASS_RELEASE: all release gates passed with unresolved P0 and P1 equal to zero

keep: quality-reviews/** acceptance, critic, judge, completion and live-readback artifacts
